name: Republic Day
description: Marks the day the Constitution of India came into force in 1950.

name: Mahashivratri
description: Hindu festival dedicated to Lord Shiva.

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Jayanti
description: Birth anniversary of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, founder of the Maratha Swarajya.

name: Holi (second day)
description: Dhulivandan, the festival of colours celebrated the day after Holika Dahan.

name: Gudhi Padwa
description: Marathi New Year, the first day of the month of Chaitra.

name: Ramzan Eid (Id-ul-Fitr)
description: Marks the end of the month of fasting (Ramzan).

name: Ram Navami
description: Birth anniversary of Lord Rama.

name: Mahavir Jayanti
description: Birth anniversary of Bhagwan Mahavir, the 24th Jain Tirthankara.

name: Good Friday
description: Observed by Christians in remembrance of the crucifixion of Jesus Christ.

name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Jayanti
description: Birth anniversary of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar, chief architect of the Constitution of India.

name: Maharashtra Day / Buddha Purnima
description: Formation of the State of Maharashtra on 1 May 1960; Buddha Purnima marks the birth and enlightenment of Gautama Buddha.

name: Bakri Id (Id-uz-Zuha)
description: Festival of sacrifice.

name: Muharram
description: Ashura, observed on the tenth day of the month of Muharram.

name: Independence Day / Parsi New Year
description: India's independence in 1947; Parsi New Year (Navroz) of the Shahenshahi calendar.

name: Id-e-Milad
description: Birth anniversary of Prophet Muhammad.

name: Ganesh Chaturthi
description: Beginning of the Ganeshotsav festival in honour of Lord Ganesha.

name: Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti
description: Birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi.

name: Dasara
description: Vijayadashami, celebrating the victory of good over evil.

name: Diwali Amavasya (Laxmi Pujan)
description: Worship of Goddess Laxmi on the new-moon day of Diwali.

name: Diwali (Balipratipada)
description: Diwali Padwa, the day of King Bali.

name: Bhaubeej
description: Last day of Diwali, celebrating the bond between brothers and sisters. Additional holiday declared for 2026.

name: Guru Nanak Jayanti
description: Birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev, the first Sikh Guru.

name: Christmas
description: Birth of Jesus Christ.
